scenarios.name: sacrificing-a-land-gains-two-life
scenarios.why: Sacrifice a land: You gain 2 life -- the land is sacrificed as the cost and the controlling player's life total rises by two.

scenarios.name: without-a-land-the-ability-is-not-offered
scenarios.why: The ability's only cost sacrifices a land; with no land on the battlefield (the Orb itself is an artifact) the cost cannot be paid, so activating it is not offered.
